A_scene.title: The night drive
A_scene.heading: SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
A_scene.purpose: Set personal concern beside Mudalali's control of Dinu's route without resolving Dinu's allegiance.
A_scene.summary: Dinu drives through Colombo while Aruni's recorded message reports Nimal's absence. Mudalali then redirects him, and Dinu changes course after looking at his wrist thread.

threads.subject: Nimal
threads.summary: Aruni's report that Nimal is missing leads chronologically to her discovery of his body, presented first as the cold open.
this_scene: Aruni reports Nimal has not returned.

knowledge.learns: Aruni reports that Nimal has not returned home and that she is afraid.

Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van. On the
dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop. Aruni's voice message

Mudalali calls. Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna. Dinu looks at the
red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.
Dinu's mobile phone. Implied by the script: Aruni's voice message plays from it (E01-S02-B03, E01-S02-B04) and Mudalali calls on it. It is the source of both voices.

E_blocks.text: Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van.

events.change: Dinu drives through the illuminated city rain.

E_blocks.intent: Establish the wet city and Dinu at work.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Keep Dinu contained within the vehicle framing.

E_blocks.text: On the dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop.

events.change: A photograph connects Dinu and Aruni with the village.

E_blocks.intent: Establish a shared past with Aruni through the dashboard image.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Let the worn photograph carry the association.

E_blocks.intent: Bring Aruni into the van through recorded audio.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Distinguish playback from a live conversation.

E_blocks.text: Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan baya hithenawa.

events.change: Dinu hears that Nimal remains absent and Aruni is frightened.

E_blocks.intent: Report Nimal's failure to return and seek reassurance from Dinu.
E_blocks.speaker: C02
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Controlled worry growing into an admission of fear.

E_blocks.intent: Shift from personal concern to an incoming directive.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Make the change of caller clear.

E_blocks.text: Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna.

events.change: Dinu receives a new destination at Old Port warehouse.

E_blocks.intent: Replace Dinu's current route with a warehouse destination.
E_blocks.speaker: C04
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Clipped authority, with no explanation added.

E_blocks.text: Dinu looks at the red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.

events.change: Dinu studies his wrist thread and steers toward the industrial district.

E_blocks.intent: Link a private pause with observable compliance, without explaining the thread.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Hold the glance before the directional change.

G_direction.text:
Colombo palette - Cold blue, green and sodium orange. Handheld camera, tight frames and
crowded backgrounds.
Lighting - Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.
Editing - Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.

Sound - Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero
elevation moments.
Slow motion - Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.
ACTION DESIGN NOTESThe action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence.
Dinu is not an invincible superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing.

Aruni is an active participant in the climax, and the final victory comes from the recording, the
village and their courage - not from violence alone.SCREENPLAY

dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop. Aruni's voice message
plays.
